_tuning_notes: Mountain gorilla: windswept hills + grove, thicker fur texture, +4 health over lowland, slightly smaller troops. Proves biome-tag species routing from the same entity class. Phase 3: forage block = melon/berry raids (mobGriefing-gated); a fed troop is 'content' for content_minutes: taming chance doubles (2/3), chest-beat cooldown doubles, roaming calms. cage_tier 2 = reinforced cage required. Phase 3.1: fur is a per-individual pick from the 'textures' list (stable per entity); the silverback saddle is a translucent overlay layer, so it composes with every fur colour instead of needing a silverback copy of each. RARITY: tier 'rare' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (3-5, cap 8). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever. VARIANT ROLLS: albino at 5% per gorilla, rolled ONCE at spawn and persisted in NBT so an individual never re-rolls; babies roll independently, so an albino born into a normal troop is the jackpot sighting. Otherwise identical — same stats, troop role and taming. Generic: any species can gain a rare coat by adding a variant_rolls entry, no Java. ECOLOGY 0.4.2: was #minecraft:is_hill + minecraft:grove — windswept hills and a SNOWY conifer forest, i.e. gorillas in the snow, the same class of error as the ocean-floor hippo. Mountain gorillas are montane bamboo-forest animals, so this is now the bamboo jungle. Cold-biome species routing is unchanged in kind; the test biome moves from grove to bamboo_jungle. BABY SIZE 0.4.2: baby_scale moved 0.5 -> 1.0. The client already bakes the baby mesh through vanilla's BabyModelTransform (body halved, head full size) and vanilla age scaling halves the hitbox, so a 0.5 here was a SECOND shrink and calves rendered at a quarter of adult size. 1.0 = vanilla baby proportions. TERRALITH PASS: bamboo jungle alone resolved to a single biome on a Terralith world. Terralith's jungle_mountains and rocky_jungle are literally montane jungle, so the mountain gorilla now has real habitat and lowland excludes it. HABITAT RESTORE 0.4.5: #minecraft:is_hill is back. Cutting this in 0.4.4 halved gorilla habitat for the sake of a tidy 'jungle-family' reading, and the field result was players not finding gorillas at all. minecraft:grove stays out — a snowy conifer forest was the genuinely wrong entry, not the windswept highlands.
guide_blurb: Thicker coat, thinner air, same rules.
